name: Veil of Secrets
source:
Your best friend vanished without a trace on the day of her wedding! Search the town of Birchport to solve the mysteries, but be careful... everyone has a secret.

[From [url=http://choices-stories-you-play.wikia.com/wiki/Veil_of_Secrets]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你最好的朋友在婚礼当天无影无踪！搜索桦港镇，解开谜团，但要小心……每个人都有秘密。

[来源：[url=http://choices-stories-you-play.wikia.com/wiki/Veil_of_Secrets]Choices Wikia[/url]]
